title: UCDSB trustees scheduled to vote on changing October 2025 meeting date
executiveSummary: A special motion to request changing the October 2025 meeting date was on the UCDSB agenda.
studentParentImpact: The Upper Canada District School Board scheduled a special meeting to consider changing its regular board meeting date for October 2025. While board meeting schedules determine when trustees gather to discuss school matters, changing a single meeting date does not directly impact daily classroom schedules, school bus routes, or learning programs for families in Brockville. The agenda did not state a proposed new date or outline any ways for students or parents to provide feedback.
policyChanges: No policy or procedure creations, revisions, or rescissions were listed on this agenda.

title: UCDSB Special Board Meeting Agenda Focuses on Private Session Items
executiveSummary: A private session report was on the agenda for the UCDSB special board meeting on July 15, 2025.
studentParentImpact: The Upper Canada District School Board special meeting agenda for July 15, 2025, consisted entirely of procedural steps and a confidential private session report. Private sessions typically cover confidential topics like legal matters, property, or personnel issues. Because no public reports or specific board proposals were included on this agenda, there are no direct impacts or operational changes for Brockville students and parents. The agenda did not list any public consultation opportunities or actionable items for local families.
policyChanges: No policy or procedure revisions were listed on this agenda.

title: UCDSB Agenda Features 2025-26 Budget and New Strategic Plan
executiveSummary: The Upper Canada District School Board was set to consider its proposed budget for the 2025-26 school year.
Trustees were scheduled to review a draft multi-year strategic plan for 2025 through 2029.
An update regarding electronic report cards and the parent document repository was on the meeting agenda.
studentParentImpact: The Upper Canada District School Board scheduled a review of its proposed budget for the 2025-26 school year, which impacts funding for classroom resources and school staffing. Trustees were also set to look at updates regarding electronic report cards and an online parent document system, which affects how families access student grades and official updates. Additionally, a land purchase in Cornwall and a draft four-year strategic plan were listed for trustee consideration. Because this agenda describes a past scheduled meeting, no immediate action or input is requested from parents or students in the provided agenda text.
policyChanges: Draft Policy 314 regarding electronic trustee meetings was on the agenda, along with proposed updates to Policy 4002 on facility collaboration and Policy 414 on asset disposal. Trustees were also set to review Procedure 311.1 covering the board member code of conduct.
